Name: AgeingMachine Compatibility for PVA
Author: WeightLossPill
Description:
[b][size=4]This mod adds alcohol items from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26042]Pretty Vanilla Alcohol[/url] to the OutputRules list of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25708]AgeingMachine[/url].[/size][/b]


This is my first time creating a functional mod.

I tried many times but failed to figure out how to add rules in the "OutputRules" of "(BC)Lukas.CPAgeingMachine_AgeingMachine".
So this mod actually overwrote the "OutputRules" of [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25708]AgeingMachine[/url][/b].

If anyone can guide me on how to directly add the rules instead of overwrite the whole "OutputRules", I would be extremely grateful!
